title: House Dance Tutorial | 30 Basic Moves And Steps For Beginners: Part 1

method.teacher_system: The teacher demonstrates house dance moves categorized by step types, showing them from the front and back views with on-screen numbers, then performs challenge variations combining the movements.

practices.what: The teacher introduces category 1 bounce using both legs with on-screen text and demonstrates the movement.
The teacher demonstrates category 2 bounce using one leg, repeating the sequence for the front and back views.
The teacher demonstrates category 3 knock with the and count, breaking down the footwork from multiple angles.
The teacher demonstrates category 4 snap kick standard version, executing the step to counts.
The teacher demonstrates category 5 knee up standard version, showing the lift and rhythm.
The teacher demonstrates category 6 toe twist, executing the twist movement with clear foot positioning.
The teacher demonstrates category 7 toe twist combined with a knee up.
The teacher demonstrates category 8 toe twist combined with a leg curl.
The teacher demonstrates category 9 heel twist, showing the twist action on the heels.
The teacher demonstrates category 10 heel twist combined with bedrock.

moments.says: The teacher welcomes learners to an introductory house dance practice covering 30 essential moves divided into 10 categories.

struggles.theme: Moves are hard to follow or track the mirroring

clicked.theme: Clear and detailed breakdown makes it easy to follow

requests.theme: Want a tutorial on how to connect moves together in a song

meant.theme: Helps fulfill dancing dreams despite lacking money for classes

method.limits: There is no spoken instruction or audio explanation in the video, only background music and on-screen text.
